study: Is the residue of section 4.1 a diffusion (SDE), an iid jump measure, or a persistent deterministic reset process - measured as the lattice it lives on, its memory, the failure of per-frame rules on the observed state, the conditioning on the richer recordings, and the calibration of three propagators against the recorded trajectories.

verdict.reading: The residual of section 4.1 takes 5-13 distinct values per recording and never leaves the sub-pixel grid (largest off-integer deviation 0.000000 sub-pixels), so no density over the reals is the right object; and the exception persists (104.0x to 625.7x the rate after a clean frame, median run 14.83 frames), so it is not white noise either. Of the four propagators the mean 90% coverage is 0.811 for drift plus iid diffusion, 0.824 for an iid jump measure, 0.861 for a two-state chain with geometric runs and 0.972 for the renewal process that samples run lengths from the recording itself. The reason none of them is needed: 75.4% of the exceptions at minimum are frames where the position does not move while the velocity byte is held, and there the residue is exactly the negative velocity.
